messages.author: 5b5ac0e901ae0add
messages.subject: Connected components in BYM models
parts:
I'm trying to estimate besag models for administrative regional data in Columbia (http://www.worldofmaps.net/en/south-america/map-colombia/map-provinces-colombia.htm).  My graph file looks correct, but I get warnings about the number of connected components (INLA reads 6 different cc's) and the model undergoing revisions accordingly.  Do you mind giving a text-book definition of a cc in this context.  I'm worried my graphing file may be incorrect, b/c single area cc's are noted for not only the islands of San Andres and Providencia (no surprise there) but also for Atlantico, Guajira, and Quindio (I guess I don't fully understand why these would be cc's on there own). 
 
Thank you.

messages.author: 5b5ac0e901ae0add
messages.subject: Re: Connected components in BYM models
parts: I upgraded to the latest INLA version this morning and graph is read as expected.  The only cc's left are the islands.  Thanks.
